purpose: Precommit the nationwide AequilibraE and ActivitySim validation design before any new calibration candidate can inspect or influence an acceptance holdout.
claimUnderTest: planning-grade nationwide baseline-versus-build comparison, with each model reported separately
permanentRules: AequilibraE and ActivitySim use the same selected geography, network version, scenario definitions, observation boundary, vehicle units, direction basis, day basis, and base year.
The two model outputs and their disagreement are retained and never averaged.
Missing coverage, ambiguous matching, unavailable source evidence, or incompatible units produce inconclusive evidence rather than zero, pass, or fail.
No state or required geographic archetype can be rescued by a national aggregate.
No result may change model defaults or acceptance thresholds after an acceptance holdout has been opened.

requiredFields: source agency and original record id
observation dates and model base year

splitDesign.unit: geographically blocked observation groups, keeping correlated stations and duplicate source lineages together
splitDesign.acceptanceHoldoutCustody: The acceptance partition remains unopened until dataset hashes, observation intervals, matching rules, model settings, metrics, and use-specific thresholds are frozen in a successor artifact.
splitDesign.currentThirtyPercentHoldout: diagnostic model-selection evidence only; it is consumed by calibration choice and is not independent accuracy evidence

requiredGeography.jurisdictions: all fifty states and the District of Columbia, assessed individually
requiredGeography.territories: explicitly assessed and never assigned state defaults

reportedMetrics: results by observation grade, facility class, geography, source method, and vintage
AequilibraE versus ActivitySim disagreement without averaging

acceptanceDecision.reason: Nationwide decisive datasets, immutable dataset hashes, observation intervals, independent geographic acceptance partitions, and use-specific acceptance thresholds are not yet frozen.
acceptanceDecision.candidateExecutionGate: No new nationwide calibration candidate may run and no sealed acceptance data may be opened until a successor preregistration fills those fields and is frozen and hashed first.

continuityDiagnosticOnly.meaning: existing bounded-screening diagnostic only; never a nationwide acceptance gate

acceptanceDecision.v1PassRule: Every state and required archetype must pass the later frozen use-specific gate for both methods separately, with adequate decisive observation coverage and no unresolved instrument or custody failure. Otherwise the applicable cell remains open.

amendmentRule: A successor may add datasets, hashes, intervals, and acceptance thresholds only before the affected sealed holdout is opened. It must cite the evidence for each change, receive a new artifact id and hash, and preserve this file byte for byte.
